description: The plot illustrates next-token prediction accuracy as a function of training step for two experiments, labeled “Ex1 Accuracy” and “Ex2 Accuracy.” The x-axis is labeled “Step,” uses a linear scale, and spans from 0 to 60,000 with regularly spaced tick labels every 10,000. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (Next Token Prediction),” uses a linear scale, and shows values roughly from 0.10 up to about 0.42 with tick labels at approximately 0.05 intervals (e.g., 0.10, 0.15, …, 0.40). The Ex1 Accuracy series is drawn as a blue solid line with circular markers; it starts near 0.09 at step 0, rises to about 0.24 at 1,000 steps, increases to about 0.39 at 7,000 steps, and then gradually climbs and flattens, reaching about 0.40 at 13,000, about 0.41 around 30,000–42,000, and ending near 0.41 at 60,000. The Ex2 Accuracy series is drawn as a teal solid line with circular markers; it starts near 0.09 at step 0, increases to about 0.27 at 1,000 steps, rises to about 0.28–0.29 by 7,000–13,000 steps, then jumps to about 0.36 at 19,000 steps and continues a slower increase, reaching about 0.38 around 30,000–42,000 and ending near 0.39 at 60,000.
